name: Spiko UK T-Bills Money Market Fund
oneLiner: UKTBL is Spiko's AMF-authorized GBP money-market fund share token, backed by short-dated UK Treasury bills and gated through Spiko's transfer agent.
collateral: GBP-denominated UK Treasury bill money-market exposure administered through Spiko fund rails.
pegMechanism: GBP-denominated NAV-accreting money-market fund share; primary subscriptions and redemptions are KYC-gated through Spiko at fund NAV.

jurisdiction.license: UCITS Short-Term VNAV Money Market Fund

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: UKTBL is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: UKTBL's chain-local EVM ADMIN Safes, Starknet admin multisig, and Stellar contract administrator are verified, but the full direct-minter inventory is not. Non-Ethereum EVM group-2 operators, additional Starknet MINTER members, and Stellar's three MINTER accounts remain unrecorded as controls; eight Ethereum mint-capable rows also retain unknown cap authority.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager ADMIN Safe (Ethereum)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25584970, getGroups() confirms this Safe holds ADMIN group 0; Safe reads returned VERSION() = 1.4.1, the six listed owners, threshold 3, no enabled modules, and a zero guard slot. UKTBL mint requires mask 0x05, while upgradeToAndCall on both the token and PermissionManager requires mask 0x01, so this Safe can authorize minters and replace mint-critical logic without a contract-enforced delay.

controls.label: UKTBL Starknet restricted mint/burn
controls.capDescription: Mint and burn are gated by the shared Spiko Starknet PermissionManager; the token owner can replace both its declared class and PermissionManager address.
controls.evidence: At Starknet block 12140924, the token's permission_manager_contract_address storage variable resolved to the issuer's production PermissionManager 0x07c7a6db2763d01aa889702bf5eb7b88a01a9df11da0e3d45c96a140c1f43ba3. Its declared class 0x5973b1bed1f0a20a9125fac8ec5499f29f44bb70d9c465658c0da20ca9b75f3 exposes mint, burn, set_permission_manager_contract_address, and OpenZeppelin IUpgradeable entrypoints.

controls.label: UKTBL Starknet token owner (Argent Multisig, 3-of-5)
controls.capDescription: Token owner and PermissionManager DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder: can upgrade the token class, replace the PermissionManager, grant mint roles, and upgrade the PermissionManager without a delay.
controls.evidence: At Starknet block 12140924, owner() on UKTBL returned this ArgentMultisig; get_threshold() returned 3 and get_signers() returned the five signer felts 0x3167aa34..., 0x4ae1bfde..., 0x3e02f370..., 0x147ecc4a..., and 0x53b475eb.... On PermissionManager 0x07c7a6db2763d01aa889702bf5eb7b88a01a9df11da0e3d45c96a140c1f43ba3, has_role() returned true for this multisig's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, and WHITELISTER_ROLE and false for BURNER_ROLE. The official source restricts PermissionManager upgrade() to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.label: UKTBL Stellar Soroban restricted mint/burn
controls.capDescription: Minting requires the shared PermissionManager MINTER role; the single-key token owner can replace the PermissionManager and upgrade the token wasm.
controls.evidence: At Stellar ledger 63588183, contract-instance storage identified UKTBL metadata, PermissionManager CBGHLRSX5D5YMBPNK4ZGMUTJUHFIT7YGXGJURM5LFNZ7B6WNSXLGS26M, and Owner GBYIQXBKEB655EB3WTRITS6RR5GXEP6SQRBLPREZHNFYKT7WBMTMPR3H. A no-op upgrade simulation against current token wasm f48f10d9c7d35fc7783b5e27578bf0e764e3a30ff26a3bd7d8e57758c17a9ea8 succeeded from that owner; the source restricts upgrades and PermissionManager replacement to the owner.

controls.label: Spiko UKTBL Stellar contract owner and PermissionManager admin (single-key account)
controls.evidence: At Stellar ledger 63588183, the shared PermissionManager stored this account as Admin and a no-op upgrade simulation against current PermissionManager wasm f4de70f678124ba1f17642e07b7a06355deb468e0df573b8897269258fb0ff1a succeeded from it. get_role_member_count(MINTER) returned 3; the three current members are GD2ELXTH...X4EO, GBWKGT3Q...XIQY, and GDUFSH23...HATC. Horizon reports the admin and all three minters as one-signer accounts with weight 1 and zero low, medium, and high thresholds, so the Stellar path is explicitly a single-key authority surface.

upgradeability.controlRef: Spiko UKTBL Stellar contract owner and PermissionManager admin (single-key account)

review.evidence: Pinned reads substantially improve UKTBL's administration inventory: EVM blocks Ethereum 25584970, Polygon 90652348, Base 48947086, Etherlink 48881439, and Arbitrum 486369724 resolve chain-local 3-of-6 ADMIN Safes with no detected modules or guards; Starknet block 12140924 resolves the token and PermissionManager administrator to a 3-of-5 Argent multisig; Stellar ledger 63588183 resolves the contract owner and PermissionManager admin to one single-key account. This is not yet a terminal mint inventory. Only Ethereum's six group-2 mint operators are recorded, the other EVM group-2 members are absent, Starknet MINTER membership was not enumerated beyond the admin, and Stellar reports three current MINTER accounts that are not represented as controls. The eight Ethereum mint-capable rows also retain canRaiseCap unknown. The AMF-regulated UCITS fund and quarterly PwC audit evidence continue to support periodic reconciliation and prudential supervision, but do not close these contract-control gaps.
review.reviewer: P2 mint-free cohort; Claude 2026-07-21 gap-fill pass; OpenAI Codex wave-4 evidence upgrade
unresolvedQuestions: Enumerate every group-2 direct minter on Polygon, Base, Etherlink, and Arbitrum and determine each mint-capable control's canRaiseCap semantics.
Enumerate all Starknet MINTER_ROLE members and record their terminal authority models.
Record the three current Stellar MINTER accounts as controls and resolve their cap authority, rather than treating the administrator as the only terminal mint surface.
Resolve canRaiseCap for the Ethereum token, PermissionManager, and six group-2 mint operators.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Spiko documents internal infrastructure for issuing, operating, and monitoring its regulated fund tokens across EVM networks, Starknet, and Stellar. For UKTBL, no independent bridge route was verified, so the route is reviewed as issuer-native multichain issuance.

sources.label: Spiko UK T-Bills Money Market Fund KID

reserveReview.rationale: The producer emits one 100% 'UK Treasury Bills and cash' identity. The KID and prospectus identify the referenced regulated fund, daily dealing, an explicit 180-day maximum residual maturity for eligible instruments, and a UK-government-instrument mandate. The prior 95/5 Treasury-bill and cash split was not a reported live allocation, so this review classifies the exact aggregate producer identity at the fund-share level.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact spiko-api single-asset identity cross-checked against Spiko's current product page, prospectus, KID, and share-class totals API
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No exposure outside the emitted aggregate fund identity is indicated. The producer does not publish separate live weights for Treasury bills and operational settlement cash, so no look-through split is authored.

sources.label: Spiko UK T-Bills Money Market Fund KID

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The KID identifies CACEIS Bank as custodian and states that the fund is separate from its management company and legally segregated from custodian assets; Spiko identifies HSBC as the UK Treasury-bill sub-custodian and GBP correspondent bank. Provider shares, the broader delegated-custody chain, and rehypothecation terms are not published.

notices.title: Low-liquidity fund token
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live price and market cap but little or no secondary-market volume; Pharos treats UKTBL as a NAV-priced fund share.
